breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out) despite stating it is a counterflow heat exchanger. The correct counterflow definitions should be ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in. The agent repeated the original error without correction.
